lin: quick note — after pushing the dual package candidate, partners reported subtle breakage across runtimes. wanted to capture steps before opening PRs.

harper: what are the observed failures?

lin: three buckets: 1) edge runtimes (Cloudflare, Bun) immediately error with "Buffer is not defined" or crash on crypto imports; 2) CJS apps using require() sometimes enter an auth retry loop on 401 because our response detection relies on instanceof; 3) TS projects (ESM-first) resolve the wrong declaration file and type errors follow.

dina: sounds like typical Node vs Web + CJS vs ESM pain. can you paste the current exports?

lin: current minimal exports: {".":{"import":"./dist/esm/index.js","require":"./dist/cjs/index.js"}}, main=dist/cjs/index.js, module=dist/esm/index.js, types=dist/esm/index.d.ts

sam: two quick recommendations: add an explicit edge condition in exports and consolidate types to a single top-level d.ts that re-exports platform types. example: exports.{".":{"types":"./dist/index.d.ts","edge":"./dist/edge/index.js","import":"./dist/esm/index.js","require":"./dist/cjs/index.js"}} and types="./dist/index.d.ts"

harper: for the Buffer/crypto problem — don't use Buffer at module top-level. either detect globalThis.Buffer or use a small helper that prefers web-crypto and falls back to node crypto. edge build should be pure ESM and avoid Node globals.

dina: for the retry looping — never use instanceof Response. instead duck-type: check resp && typeof resp.status==='number' && typeof resp.json==='function'. add unit tests that simulate cross-realm Response (e.g., node-fetch in CJS).

sam: CJS shim trick reduces interop surprises: dist/cjs/index.js can be a tiny wrapper that requires the ESM output and exports default when present. e.g. const m=require('../esm'); module.exports = m && m.__esModule ? m.default : m;

harper: watch out for top-level await in ESM entrypoints — some bundlers crash. move async init behind factory (createClient).

lin: CI/playbook changes: add smoke matrix (node-cjs, node-esm, vite, cloudflare worker, bun, TSstrictESM tsserver check). failing fast in CI will save user pain.

ci-bot: opened issue #5012 "publish playbook: dual build smoke matrix + edge export" and queued canary 0.13.1-canary.

dina: action items — I'll send PR to replace instanceof checks, add duck-typing tests. harper: produce edge build and README snippet about polyfills. sam: add cjs shim and unified index.d.ts. lin: update changelog and add migration note.

harper: small note for docs — mention direct import path (pkg/edge) for consumers whose bundlers ignore custom "edge" condition. also document fallback polyfills: globalThis.Buffer or crypto polyfill.

lin: great. I'll link PRs here when ready. thanks all. :thumbsup:
